captions_note: everything sits above the head, so the reel's captions keep running
in_a_reel: the call to action: start the slot about 0.5 s before the keyword is said, 3 to 5 s long
HANDLE is the buyer's real handle; no real product's logo or interface: plain cards
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's fonts and colours before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: edit KEYWORD, HANDLE and REPLIES in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # writes the two-tone mask, prints the times, the place and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
